subject: [Policy Signal] SB 452 (GA) — JPMorgan Chase
body: 1. Why now — Georgia signed Act 414 increasing the maximum 401(k) employer contribution for state law enforcement officers. 2. Why this account — JPMorgan Chase administers a meaningful share of public-sector defined contribution plans nationally and Georgia plan sponsors will need new contribution-cap logic by year-end. 3. Suggested open — Lead with the implementation timeline question and offer to walk through how peers are sequencing the change.
